label: Phase 2 fix api/configuration.py FieldErrors and add balance credit/debit admin action
instruction: Replace modules/leave_elm/api/configuration.py to fix the FieldError crashes (`filter(user=...)` on LeavePolicy and `filter(leave_application__user=...)` on LeaveHistory) and support both GET and POST on ConfigurationView and RecordListView. Specifically: (1) Use APIView from rest_framework.views, Response from rest_framework.response, IsAuthenticatedPrincipal, HasModuleGrant, HasPermission from fusion_auth.permissions, and @extend_schema(responses=OpenApiTypes.OBJECT) from drf_spectacular. (2) In ConfigurationView: permission_classes = [IsAuthenticatedPrincipal, HasModuleGrant('leave_elm'), HasPermission('leave_elm.configuration.manage')]. GET ensures a default LeavePolicy(name='Default') and LeaveCalendar(name='Default', user_id=request.principal.user_id, holidays=[]) exist and returns {'policy': LeavePolicySerializer(policy).data, 'calendar': LeaveCalendarSerializer(calendar).data, 'policies': LeavePolicySerializer(LeavePolicy.objects.all(), many=True).data, 'calendars': LeaveCalendarSerializer(LeaveCalendar.objects.all(), many=True).data}. POST updates or creates LeavePolicy and LeaveCalendar from request.data.get('policy') and request.data.get('calendar') (passing user_id=request.principal.user_id on LeaveCalendar), and if request.data.get('run_rollover') is True, runs year_end_rollover(). Return status=200. (3) In RecordListView: permission_classes = [IsAuthenticatedPrincipal, HasModuleGrant('leave_elm'), HasPermission('leave_elm.record.manage')]. GET returns {'applications': LeaveApplicationSerializer(LeaveApplication.objects.select_related('leave_type', 'leave_type__leave_category').order_by('-created_at')[:100], many=True).data, 'balances': LeaveBalanceSerializer(LeaveBalance.objects.select_related('leave_category').order_by('user_id', 'id')[:200], many=True).data, 'history': LeaveHistorySerializer(LeaveHistory.objects.order_by('-created_at')[:100], many=True).data, 'notifications': LeaveNotificationSerializer(LeaveNotification.objects.order_by('-created_at')[:100], many=True).data}. POST allows admin balance adjustment (user_id, category_code, balance or delta_days) and returns the updated LeaveBalanceSerializer(balance_obj).data. Return only valid Python code.
